name: foundation20
rationale: Shared 20,000,000-step cold-start locomotion foundation. All v5007 phase-1 branches warm-start from this exact policy; this run is not itself an experimental branch.

name: slew_static
rationale: Clean actuator-interface control: fixed v5005 athletic envelope with the old 4 rad/s software target slew retained.

name: noslew_static
rationale: No artificial target slew, but otherwise keep the proven v5005 athletic envelope fixed. Clean actuator-interface baseline.

name: frontier_axis
rationale: Repaired settled edge-tracking frontier without combo sampling. Tests the governor itself before mixed-command geometry.

name: frontier_repaired
rationale: Primary v5007 command experiment: repaired edge frontier + p=1.35 mixed commands + 20% full athletic-envelope rehearsal.

name: frontier_no_rehearsal
rationale: Ablates full-envelope rehearsal. If late yaw/dynamic forgetting returns, rehearsal is causal rather than decorative.

name: frontier_push
rationale: Repaired command frontier plus the v5006 lever that genuinely expanded: competence-driven push force.

name: frontier_accel
rationale: Repaired command frontier plus transition timing controlled by direct ramp-tracking competence.

name: frontier_push_accel
rationale: Tests whether the two v5006 frontiers that actually worked compose once command-frontier measurement is repaired.

name: frontier_lower_kl
rationale: Tests the 0.025 KL hypothesis without changing the curriculum or actuator interface.

name: resilience_focus
rationale: Allows curriculum to tolerate a harder fall band while manoeuvring under stronger pushes; asks whether resilience75 can rise without trading away command fidelity.

name: sensor_frontier_repaired
rationale: Re-tests deployable sensor-margin growth now that vy/yaw precision no longer starts below its own measurement tolerance.

name: frontier_beast2
rationale: Retest the broad v5006 combination only after fixing the governor; determines whether beast-style training was inherently conflicting or merely poisoned by the old frontier gate.

name: resilience_focus__confirm
rationale: Allows curriculum to tolerate a harder fall band while manoeuvring under stronger pushes; asks whether resilience75 can rise without trading away command fidelity.

name: sensor_frontier_repaired__confirm
rationale: Re-tests deployable sensor-margin growth now that vy/yaw precision no longer starts below its own measurement tolerance.

name: sensor_frontier_repaired__phase2
rationale: Re-tests deployable sensor-margin growth now that vy/yaw precision no longer starts below its own measurement tolerance.
